build_args: FLEET_SHAPE_BLEND=1, then <catalina22.json from Tools/BoatExport> Catalina22 <out dir>: reads <out>/Catalina22_shape.blend
note: Today's Catalina 22 (the shared fleet template, docs/c22-1): the 'before' every slice of the rebuild is compared against. build_fleet.py builds her hull shell into Catalina22_Hull, the deck moulding into Catalina22_Deck, the cockpit well into Catalina22_Well, the cabin trunk into Catalina22_Cabin (tagged with shape_part since docs/c22-1), the swing keel into Catalina22_Board, and everything else (lifelines, pulpits, deck and cockpit detail, the kit hardware) into Catalina22_Fittings; the rudder, mast and boom are their own objects as in the game. Rules as in sections_j22.json: an entry ending in '_' or '*' is a name prefix, any other an exact name; unmatched is 'other' (the rig).
joins_note: No joins checked for today's model; slice 1 lists the new hull's joins (hull to deck at the sheer, keel trunk to hull).
